card.text: Young Sun-like star 27 parsecs away in Lepus, with a Jupiter-like planet photographed directly.

introduction.text: AF Lep is a young star in the beta Pictoris moving group, 24 million years old. Its pull on the star led astronomers to its planet b in 2023.

sources.label: Franson et al. 2023
sources.quote: stars with astrometric accelerations between Hipparcos and Gaia

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of Gaia's spectrum of the star. No surface picture exists.
